name: the underground classroom of the Decentralized University
about: The foil-lined basement room where Zei's secret physics class meets, and is bombed, in chapter 2. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Fin and Zei were led down two flights of somewhat dusty stairs.
entered a large room, and sat down beside each other on one of the rows of chairs
facts.fact: A large room with rows of chairs.

facts.quote: The walls were covered with a thick, hastily organized layer of anti-transmission foil.
facts.fact: Walls thickly and hastily covered in foil.

facts.quote: pictures of cute cartoon animals playing with electronic gadgets and chemistry lab equipment, with a backdrop of green trees and blue skies
facts.fact: Cartoon animal pictures painted on the foil.

facts.quote: an inflated cartoon-style pig on the left and a hamster on the right
facts.fact: An inflated cartoon pig and hamster at the front.

facts.quote: The pig, in its left hand, was holding a calculator.
The hamster, in its right hand, was holding a vial of some green liquid.
facts.fact: The hamster holds a vial of green liquid.

facts.quote: a slide showed up on the front wall
facts.fact: Slides show on the front wall.

facts.quote: part of the wall and the floor came crashing down
facts.fact: The blast breaks the wall and floor.

descriptor: a large windowless basement classroom with rows of simple chairs, its walls thickly and hastily covered in crinkled silver anti-transmission foil painted over with cute cartoon animals playing with gadgets and lab glassware against green trees and blue skies, a projected slide of simple diagrams glowing on the front wall, and two big inflatable cartoon animals, a pig and a hamster, flanking it
